review_state: C31/C32/C33 and green C93 physical positions photo-registered by exact assembly order and owner views; all owner rail joins open
source_observation: The .009 assembly explicitly orders C31, C32, small C93, and C33 above X8. Its polarity marks put C31 and C32 positive on the right and C33 positive on the left. Exact sheet-1 X8 supply detail explicitly draws C93 between ground and +12 V. The nearby collective C82...C93 text sits beside the separate +5 V/GND bypass symbol, but cannot override the individual C93 branch. The same detail draws C31 +5 V/GND, C32 +12 V/GND with its positive plate at +12 V, and C33 GND/-12 V with its positive plate at ground.
owner_observation: In the X8/power corner of 200450127, the upper and middle metal cans both show positive right leads, matching the assembly C31/C32 polarity order. The lower large can sits below a short green horizontal axial body, with a board '+' at its left lead, matching the assembly C33 left-positive mark. The July close-up 200450127 reads 47 uF/63 V on the upper can and 22 uF/16 V on the middle can. The May close-up 202054713 clearly reads 47 uF, 35 V on the lower can; this is the installed-body value read at the C33 assembly position, not a schematic value or rail-continuity result. The green body lies between the 22 uF and lower cans around image centre (1145,2220); its leads meet distinct narrow front-copper strips around x1110 and x1190. Overlap photo 200439607 repeats the arrangement. The unique three-can order and matching right/right/left positive marks identify the photographed upper, middle, and lower cans as C31, C32, and C33 assembly positions respectively. Their rail joins and the green-body rail joins are not continuity-proved; the green marking is unreadable.
copper_boundary: The two front strips at the green-body leads descend beneath the lower can, hiding their local continuation. The corresponding X8-side solder tile 200537608 exposes several wide runs and separately '+'-marked landings for the power connector, but no local front-to-back fit uniquely maps the green leads onto those joints. Board '+' marks beside electrolytics identify their own polarity, not the green body's +5 V terminal.
marking_recheck: Native July 200450127 crop (850,1850)-(1550,2600) shows the green axial body side-on between C32 and C33. Only a narrow dark-green face is exposed; the rest lies below the adjacent cans and no characters or color bands can be resolved at original pixels. Overlap 200439607 exposes the surrounding copper but cuts off the green body at its lower edge. This is an optical limit of the archived views, so another enhancement of these two crops cannot establish C93's value or technology; inspect the physical body from a lower angle or isolate-measure it.
may_green_part_screen: The independent May 19 close-up PXL_20260519_202054713.jpg has a much more visible green rectangular part near original pixels (2825,2675), below a horizontal red resistor and beside a large DIP package. It is physically below and away from the C31/C32/C33 can row, not the small green axial C93 body visible between C32 and C33 in July crop (850,1850)–(1550,2600). Do not use the May rectangular part's appearance or unreadable marking as C93 value evidence. The May angle leaves the actual inter-can C93 body obscured by the cans.
decision: Promote the physical positions: upper 47 uF/63 V is C31, middle 22 uF/16 V is C32, the small green axial body between C32/C33 occupies C93, and lower 47 uF/35 V is C33. The match uses the exact assembly order, owner positions, and the three cans’ matching polarity marks. These are owner-installed body observations, not factory schematic values or rail-continuity results. C93 marking and all individual owner rail joins remain open.
next_inspection: With power removed, measure C31 to +5 V/GND, C32 to +12 V/GND, C33 to GND/-12 V, and both green C93 leads separately to known +12 V and ground. Isolate-measure C93 if its in-circuit capacitance is ambiguous.
